title: S. Hashimoto, Japanene Counterfeiter Of Bank-Notes

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
& S. D. REGISTRY
S. B. D. 2042
S. 2. 3/3/31 Station,
Date March 2, 1931.

REPORT

Subject (in full) S. Hashimoto, Japanese counterfeiter of bank-notes.

Made by J.D.S. Umemoto. Forwarded by Wm. Quean W.S.D.

Sir,

Enquiries made in connection with the
attached newspaper translation of February 14, 1931 from
the Shanghai Mainichi re the arrest of a Japanese named
Susumu Hashimoto, 35, brass-smith by profession, native
of Osaka, show that he arrived in Shanghai from Nanking
on the morning of February 2, 1931. He resided at the
Hinomaru Kwan Hotel, 226 Woosung Road.

Acting on the instructions of the Japanese
Consular Police at Tsingtao, the local Japanese Consular
Police arrested him on February 9, 1931 at the Hotel on a
charge of counterfeiting Bank of China notes for circulation
in foreign countries.

During his detention at the Consulate
pending the arrival of a warrant from the Tsingtao Police,
no inquiries were made by the local Consular Police.

He is reported to have been engaged in
Tsingtao with three Chinese who have not yet been arrested
in the manufacture of counterfeit $5.00 notes of the Bank
of China, circulating in Tsingtao.

He was escorted to Tsingtao aboard the
S.S. "Hoten Maru" on February 20, 1931.

No further information is at present
available. A further report will be submitted upon the
receipt of any information regarding this person.

（批：Len 4/3）
（批：Jds 8.3.31）

Umemoto
J. D. S.

D. C. (C. & S. Branches)

报告

事由（全称） S. Hashimoto，日本籍伪钞制造者。

呈报人：J.D.S. Umemoto。转呈人：Wm. Quean，西区警署（W.S.D.）。

敬启者：

就1931年2月14日《上海每日新闻》（Shanghai Mainichi）关于逮捕一名名为Susumu Hashimoto、35岁、职业为铜匠、籍贯大阪的日本人的报道译文所进行的查询显示，该人于1931年2月2日上午从南京抵达上海。他居住在吴淞路226号的日之丸馆酒店（Hinomaru Kwan Hotel）。

根据青岛日本领事警察的指示，本地日本领事警察于1931年2月9日在该酒店将其逮捕，罪名为伪造中国银行钞票以供在国外流通。

在等待青岛警方逮捕令到达期间，该人被拘留于领事馆，本地领事警察未进行任何讯问。

据报，他在青岛与三名尚未被捕的中国人勾结，制造在中国银行五元面额伪钞，并在青岛流通。

他于1931年2月20日由“宝天丸”号（S.S. "Hoten Maru"）轮船押解至青岛。

目前暂无进一步消息。一旦收到有关此人的任何信息，将提交后续报告。

（批注：Len 4/3）
（批注：Jds 8.3.31）

Umemoto
J. D. S.

副督察长（刑事及特别分部）

II. 通函

逮捕日本伪钞制造者

《上海每日新闻》刊登如下报道：-

根据青岛日本领事警察的指示，本地日本领事警察近日在吴淞路（Booseung Road）的日出馆酒店（Hinode Kwan Hotel）逮捕了一名名为 S. Hashimoto、35岁的日本人，罪名为伪造钞票。
